Let me analyze the opponent's team and figure out the best 3 Pokémon to bring.

Opponent's team:
- Toxapex (Poison/Water) - very defensive, can stall with Toxic Spikes/Recover
- Garchomp (Dragon/Ground) - fast physical attacker, Earthquake, Dragon Claw, etc.
- Greninja (Water/Dark) - very fast, mixed attacker, could have Protean
- Charizard (Fire/Flying) - Mega Charizard X or Y likely, strong special/physical attacker
- Toxicroak (Poison/Fighting) - physical attacker, can set up with Swords Dance
- Goodra (Dragon) - special wall, can set up with Dragon Pulse, etc.

My options:
- Kingambit (Dark/Steel) - Swords Dance sweeper, sucker punch priority
- Gholdengo (Steel/Ghost) - special attacker, Good as Gold blocks status
- Dragapult (Dragon/Ghost) - fast, Choice Scarf, good coverage
- Corviknight (Flying/Steel) - defensive, Body Press, Roost, U-turn
- Clefable (Fairy) - Calm Mind, Moonblast, Unaware
- Rotom-Wash (Electric/Water) - Volt Switch, Will-O-Wisp, bulky

Key threats:
- Garchomp: Earthquake hits Kingambit super effectively. Corviknight resists Ground. Clefable resists Dragon but not Ground. Dragapult resists Dragon.
- Greninja: Fast, Protean could be tricky. Kingambit's Sucker Punch can hit it. Corviknight is weak to Water but resists Dark. Gholdengo resists Dark but is weak to Water.
- Charizard: Mega Charizard X (Dragon/Fire) - Kingambit resists Fire, Gholdengo resists Fire. Mega Charizard Y (Fire/Flying) - Corviknight resists Fire, Kingambit resists Fire.
- Toxapex: Very bulky, hard to break through. Clefable can Calm Mind through it. Gholdengo can hit with Shadow Ball.
- Toxicroak: Fighting type, Kingambit resists Fighting. Corviknight is weak to Fighting.
- Goodra: Special wall, physical attackers do better against it.

Strategy considerations:
- Kingambit: Great against Toxicroak (resists Fighting, Steel moves hit), can Sucker Punch Greninja. Weak to Ground (Garchomp). Can Swords Dance up.
- Gholdengo: Good against Fairy types (not present here), Steel moves hit Charizard/Toxapex. Shadow Ball hits Garchomp? No, Garchomp is Dragon/Ground, not Ghost-weak. Good as Gold blocks Will-O-Wisp/Toxic.
- Dragapult: Fast, Dragon Darts hits Garchomp, Fire Blast hits Steel types. Good coverage.
- Corviknight: Walls Garchomp (resists Ground and Dragon), can Body Press. Good defensive pivot.
- Clefable: Calm Mind + Moonblast can sweep through Dragon types (Garchomp, Goodra). Unaware blocks setup.
- Rotom-Wash: Walls Garchomp (resists Ground), Will-O-Wisp, Volt Switch for pivoting.

I think a good core would be:
1. Kingambit - Swords Dance sweeper, Sucker Punch priority, handles Toxicroak and Greninja well
2. Gholdengo - Special attacker, Good as Gold blocks status from Toxapex, can set up Nasty Plot
3. Dragapult - Fast revenge killer, Dragon Darts hits Garchomp, Fire Blast for coverage

Wait, let me reconsider. Garchomp is a big threat with Earthquake hitting Kingambit super effectively. 

Alternative: Kingambit, Corviknight, Gholdengo
- Corviknight walls Garchomp
- Kingambit handles Toxicroak, Greninja
- Gholdengo handles Toxapex, Charizard

Or: Kingambit, Dragapult, Gholdengo
- Dragapult outspeeds Garchomp and can hit with Dragon Darts
- Kingambit handles Fighting and Dark types
- Gholdengo handles Fairy and has good bulk

I think Kingambit, Gholdengo, Dragapult is a solid offensive core. Dragapult can revenge kill Garchomp with Dragon Darts, Kingambit can Swords Dance through Toxicroak/Greninja, and Gholdengo can handle Toxapex with Shadow Ball and Nasty Plot.

Let me go with Kingambit, Gholdengo, Dragapult as my lead is Kingambit for Sucker Punch priority and Swords Dance setup potential.
